ns2:section.sectionText: This course offers an in-depth exploration of the essential design concepts required for successful advertising in both print and digital landscapes. Students will learn to integrate fundamental design principles with tactical skills to create compelling, accessible, and brand-consistent advertising campaigns within industry standard programs. This course is ideal for those who want to build a strong foundation in advertising design while developing the practical skills needed for building creative and effective advertisements in the industry. If seats are available, they will open to sophomores-seniors on campus by Noon on November 20.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Not intended for students with Freshman class standing.
